summary: Implemented the rotate command (logkeep/rotate.py, logkeep/policy.py, cli wiring) per docs/rotate.md and policy.md; unit tests pass and a run on a copy of data works. One deviation from the docs: a new dated archive gets K = highest K of that day + 1, because the provided test requires it and the docs text (lowest unused K) would put the new archive older than existing ones.
